normal.name: Cambionn
normal.text: I've been really enjoying #PlanetZoo2 🐯! Perfect release date, right at the start of my pregnancy leave 😏. It runs great on the Steam Deck. Controls are surprisingly complete for controllers and performance is good even after upping the graphics. Only bug I've had so far was ringtail lemurs launching themselves out of their habitat 🚀. Which was a bit frustrating but also kinda funny. It that got fixed in today's patch luckily. Now they behave like animals again, instead of rockets 😅. #steamdeck #gaming #gamingonlinux #linuxgaming #planetzoo #zootycoon

normal.name: Geek Realm Hub
normal.text: Fortnite is coming to Linux! Epic is rebuilding Easy Anti-Cheat as EAC Linux v2, aiming for Windows-level protection. Fortnite will test it first, with support for other multiplayer games to follow. The #EpicGames Launcher is already in #Linux preview, but #Fortnite has no release date yet. Secure Boot and TPM 2.0 are among the planned security requirements. #LinuxGaming #GeekRealmHub
